title: Digi Fold
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: A master wavefolder with a continuous fold type spread over four modes: CLEAN (fold only, 36% range), MUD (fold only, full range), DIST (fold at 36% + a hard-clip overdrive) and TRSH (fold at full range + the overdrive). The type is 0..127, interpolated between adjacent modes for smooth selection and capped at CLEAN/TRSH; the overdrive is a stateless gain-into-clamp. An on/off and an amount; amount 0 is 1.0x (no fold). Runs after the ring and the EQ (ring -> EQ -> fold). Combines with every mod.
